name: Alcimus
description: Desirous to be high priest, captain of the wicked and ungodly men of Israel who accused Judas and his brethren to Demetrius; made high priest and sent with Bacchides against Israel; trusted by the Assideans as a priest of the seed of Aaron, who then slew threescore of them in one day; contended for the high priesthood and pulled down the wall of the inner court of the sanctuary, and died of a sudden affliction

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Alcimus
cases.charge: Slandering Judas to the king; slaying sixty Asideans under a sworn peace; pulling down the wall of the inner court
